item.title: Islamic Relief calls for Eid ceasefire as war intensifies across the Middle East
item.description: As the holy month draws to a close, millions of families will be spending Eid in grief, fear and uncertainty. We are seeing the most dangerous military escalation in a generation, and its deadly impact is being felt all over the world.

item.title: From our CEO: Our urgent appeal for an Eid ceasefire
item.description: It is hard not to despair. But Ramadan reminds us that the values the world needs most – compassion, solidarity, the obligation of the powerful to protect the vulnerable – have outlasted every crisis in human history. They will outlast this one too.
